Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 21, "heading": "CHAPTER XIX", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u021-r0046", "target": "— Ими можно купить весь мир.", "source_sha256": "29bad535719d22e954a4ae3cb7165e21fc98e3974544038d4ee4172d665ff54d", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u021-r0046", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ec0cdf0c7097660ab8c6baaae6c32ca07b48e2e9333104ad6780ec43c1dd3ba9"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u021-r0047", "target": "— Полно, — сказала Королева. — Вы мужчина. Вы держали женщин в объятиях. Купят ли они женщин?", "source_sha256": "f7cae6f4581a0b35f5ee5227cf34f543270eab1e75eb72bbc735cafed38a8853", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u021-r0047", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5f3e72ca7dfd43998c5cac15c8bbc0248b2970edc88ee2bb55a6c8f42a6e0506"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u021-r0048", "tag": "p", "text": "“Since the beginning of time women have been bought and sold for them, and for them women have sold themselves.”", "sha256": "a515c24c244e0c907a5b327df372943d6b1b3f1d04530bf15cc64fe2be2a802a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1810]", "source_html": "

“Since the beginning of time women have been bought 194and sold for them, and for them women have sold themselves.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0049", "tag": "p", "text": "“Will they buy me the heart of your good friend Francis?”", "sha256": "1b98c7bf12973b626fc540794ce63279d1493b81072758e8db2b21751b37d7be", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1811]", "source_html": "

“Will they buy me the heart of your good friend Francis?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0050", "tag": "p", "text": "For the first time Torres looked at her, and nodded and muttered, his eyes swimming with drink and wild-eyed with sight of such array of gems.", "sha256": "f4c533610b6e6206f06fd4c068de9085dd1e63fbd4f259a9a963372ae883db05", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1812]", "source_html": "

For the first time Torres looked at her, and nodded and muttered, his eyes swimming with drink and wild-eyed with sight of such array of gems.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0051", "tag": "p", "text": "“Will good Francis so value them?”", "sha256": "46995aa885edf0b09126aba2331e402f4b3329fe5a025cc21ae589688ce091e3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1813]", "source_html": "

“Will good Francis so value them?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0052", "tag": "p", "text": "Torres nodded speechlessly.", "sha256": "43eaa714b8104c5e3576d794bc1621f062135eab0c56f45e7c67e2abe379640f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1814]", "source_html": "

Torres nodded speechlessly.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0053", "tag": "p", "text": "“Do all persons so value them?”", "sha256": "63d5755c97858c61a556f228861bf353943c54d5411171185f69dac89c69b546", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1815]", "source_html": "

“Do all persons so value them?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0054", "tag": "p", "text": "Again he nodded emphatically.", "sha256": "f84f9380fd3220a29c249a06dfd8e336cd1ad6646bb59d185edd6e888306511c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1816]", "source_html": "

Again he nodded emphatically.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0055", "tag": "p", "text": "She began to laugh in silvery derision. Bending, at haphazard she clutched a priceless handful of the pretties.", "sha256": "4443ab748c7ba0c0b7ab0468d9f95460f4a65357e7240435d4aac4b725480cbd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1817]", "source_html": "

She began to laugh in silvery derision. Bending, at haphazard she clutched a priceless handful of the pretties.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0056", "tag": "p", "text": "“Come,” she commanded. “I will show you how I value them.”", "sha256": "70a8716dac147269eadb35e25023195c64df12e2927e3edacb5574018543d0fc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1818]", "source_html": "

“Come,” she commanded. “I will show you how I value them.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0057", "tag": "p", "text": "She led him across the room and out on a platform that extended around three sides of a space of water, the fourth side being the perpendicular cliff. At the base of the cliff the water formed a whirlpool that advertised the drainage exit for the lake which Torres had heard the Morgans speculate about.", "sha256": "50ebf6992154f0445146af54199f8dc22a35eb872ab45d310a4b40c5e53c7b70", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1819]", "source_html": "

She led him across the room and out on a platform that extended around three sides of a space of water, the fourth side being the perpendicular cliff. At the base of the cliff the water formed a whirlpool that advertised the drainage exit for the lake which Torres had heard the Morgans speculate about.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0058", "tag": "p", "text": "With another silvery tease of laughter, the Queen tossed the handful of priceless gems into the heart of the whirlpool.", "sha256": "37177bd2c3ac5feeca3b6c1434c8768a369f2a356bda43f4a7a8beaf3ea66dd0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1820]", "source_html": "

With another silvery tease of laughter, the Queen tossed the handful of priceless gems into the heart of the whirlpool.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0059", "tag": "p", "text": "“Thus I value them,” she said.", "sha256": "1b91fd98f51e8cb8194ab9dbb09656adb7aef96f293226d07011cc2ca5c3d1d1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1821]", "source_html": "

“Thus I value them,” she said.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0060", "tag": "p", "text": "Torres was aghast, and, for the nonce, well-nigh sobered by such wantonness.", "sha256": "8cbf034e503ae455c5e16d25686c1d053ebafd12a40b11580ac0efc90c99d01f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1822]", "source_html": "

Torres was aghast, and, for the nonce, well-nigh sobered by such wantonness.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0061", "tag": "p", "text": "“And they never come back,” she laughed on. “Nothing ever comes back. Look!”", "sha256": "9a6308e9092a046e3dfbc2f757aad5efdec2dde6bd901dfcf83912a05cbbf59c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1823]", "source_html": "

“And they never come back,” she laughed on. “Nothing ever comes back. Look!”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0062", "tag": "p", "text": "She flung in a handful of flowers that raced around and around the whirl and quickly sucked down from sight in the center of it.", "sha256": "78f09e2034ccddf38348571f01af6136722360d65f93da65ce92aae2a7f59c72", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1824]", "source_html": "

She flung in a handful of flowers that raced around and around the whirl and quickly sucked down from sight in the center of it.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0063", "tag": "p", "text": "“If nothing comes back, where does everything go?” Torres asked thickly.", "sha256": "991e95094f622d782fa16791eb7bac081111075ef075262b58a8fb5056094370", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1825]", "source_html": "

“If nothing comes back, where does everything go?” Torres asked thickly.
